title: From Refusal Tokens to Refusal Control: Discovering and Steering Category-Specific Refusal Directions
abstract: arXiv:2603.13359v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models are commonly fine-tuned for safety alignment to refuse harmful prompts. One approach fine-tunes them to generate categorical refusal tokens that distinguish different refusal types before responding. In this work, we leverage a version of Llama 3 8B fine-tuned with these categorical refusal tokens to enable inference-time control over fine-grained refusal behavior, improving both safety and reliability. We show that refusal token fine-tuning induces separable, category-aligned directions in the residual stream, which we extract and use to construct categorical steering vectors with a lightweight probe that determines whether to steer toward or away from refusal during inference. translated_title: 从拒绝令牌到拒绝控制：发现并引导特定类别的拒绝方向
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.13359v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：语言模型通常通过安全对齐的微调来拒绝有害提示。其中一种方法是将模型微调为在响应之前生成能够区分不同拒绝类型的分类拒绝令牌。在这项工作中，我们利用一个经过此类分类拒绝令牌微调的 Llama 3 8B 版本，实现对细粒度拒绝行为的推理时控制，从而同时提升安全性与可靠性。我们表明，拒绝令牌微调会在残差流中诱导出可分离的、与类别对齐的方向；我们提取这些方向并构建分类引导向量，同时使用一个轻量级探针来决定在推理时是向拒绝方向引导还是远离拒绝方向引导。此外，我们引入了一种学习得到的低秩组合，将这些类别方向混合到白化的正交归一引导基中，在激活空间各向异性的条件下形成单一可控的干预，并展示了这种干预……
tldr: 该论文发现拒绝令牌微调会在模型残差流中诱导出类别对齐的可分离拒绝方向，并通过轻量级探针和学习到的低秩引导组合实现对细粒度拒绝行为的推理时精准控制，同时提升模型的安全性与可靠性。
en_tdlr: This paper discovers that refusal-token fine-tuning induces separable, category-aligned refusal directions in the residual stream, and enables inference-time fine-grained control of refusal behavior through a lightweight probe and a learned low-rank steering combination, improving both safety and reliability.
